title: Matchlens — understand the moment, explore the next move

scenes.title: The score is only the beginning
scenes.narration: Northbridge are two-nil down. The pressure is shifting. A comeback is building—but the scoreline hasn’t caught up.

scenes.title: Live football intelligence
scenes.narration: I built Matchlens to explain the game behind the score, for fans and broadcasters. This demonstration uses synthetic, football-realistic events and tracking, with entirely fictional teams and players.

scenes.title: Explain. Inspect. Replay.
scenes.narration: Watch the momentum shift. Matchlens connects pressure and key events into an explanation. Open the evidence, inspect the supporting numbers, then replay the moment with tactical annotations.

scenes.title: Specialists, grounded in evidence
scenes.narration: Specialist agents explain each moment. Their claims are checked against deterministic statistics before producer and personaliser agents create the audience experiences.

scenes.title: Trust when the feed changes
scenes.narration: Live data changes. Here, the feed corrects a goalscorer. Matchlens updates affected statistics and insights, and retracts explanations that no longer hold.

scenes.title: Explore the next move
scenes.narration: For coaches, freeze a match moment and ask for tactical ideas. Compare each idea with the baseline, watch ten-second simulated outcomes, and inspect the benefits, risks, and uncertainty.

scenes.title: One match. Every audience.
scenes.narration: Now, one match becomes four experiences: a casual fan in Hindi, an analyst in English, a player-focused fan in Spanish, and a coach receiving tactical recommendations. Same match data. Different depth, language, and perspective.

scenes.title: Ask. Catch up. Stay in the game.
scenes.narration: You could ask, why did the momentum change? The answer brings supporting numbers and links back to match moments. Missed the action? Generate a catch-up that explains the story so far.

scenes.title: Built with Microsoft and Azure
scenes.narration: Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure OpenAI power Matchlens, with Azure Container Apps and Cosmos DB.

scenes.title: Every moment, understood
scenes.narration: Matchlens. Beyond the scoreline. Every match, understood.
